mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and metabolic alkalosis can worsen glucose control and increase cardiovascular risk in diabetic patients; pioglitazone increases fluid retention which may counteract diuretic efficacy and exacerbate heart failure.
action: Monitor serum potassium, glucose levels, and fluid status regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing diuretic; assess for worsening edema or heart failure symptoms.
